lesson: Thursday's one bet landed: Olympiakos won 1-0 at Marseille at about 2.90 for +$14.71. The rest of the European night was priced fairly or too short, so we stayed out and kept the card to a single bet.

matches.analysis: Prices: Lyon 2.20 / Draw 3.40 / Crystal Palace 3.00. Over 2.5 1.67 / Under 2.5 2.20; BTTS Yes 1.57 / No 2.30. matches.match: Red Bull Salzburg vs AC Milan
matches.analysis: Prices: Salzburg 3.25 / Draw 3.60 / Milan 2.05. Over 2.5 1.67 / Under 2.5 2.20; BTTS Yes 1.57 / No 2.38. Salzburg have been unbeaten in 15 competitive games and are second in Austria. Milan lost 2-0 to Benfica in their opener, are unbeaten in Serie A and may rotate, and Gabbia is out for about four months. Salzburg or draw is priced at about 1.75, which is close to fair. No bet.

Celta have drawn four of their last five league games and kept consecutive clean sheets. Under 2.5 at 1.73 and the draw at 3.25 are both priced fairly for that picture. No bet.

Prices: Marseille 2.25 / Draw 3.40 / Olympiakos 2.90. Over 2.5 1.73 / Under 2.5 2.10; BTTS Yes 1.57 / No 2.38. Marseille are 32nd in the league phase, lost five in a row before the international break (including 4-1 at Besiktas), have lost back-to-back home games and conceded six in their last three. They are without Hojbjerg and Cornelius. Olympiakos have won three straight, have lost once in five away games and have only El Kaabi and Yazici out. They are 13th and carry more momentum than the price suggests. Marseille have won four of six meetings, which keeps the stake moderate. Olympiakos to win at 2.90 is the value. Take 2.75 or better. The stake is 1.5%.
